t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The amount of mushrooms gnomes harvest increases and decreases over time. Once a gnome has harvested a lot of mushrooms for a few rounds, they will start to harvest less. So pick a different gnome for a few rounds.

vb_textbox.text: Different coloured gnomes will harvest more mushrooms over time before decreasing the amount they harvest. If a particular gnome has been harvesting a lot, try choosing a different coloured gnome before choosing the same colour again.
